requirements.description: Review exact component ratings and tolerances, effective MLCC capacitance under bias/temperature, inductor saturation and load-dependent converter limits.
Review peak/RMS currents, minimum copper/plating, pad neckdowns, every via/barrel and permitted drop/temperature; resistance is not ampacity.
Review actual filled copper against reference layout: critical loops, quiet feedback/sense, local returns, thermal paths and host-board adaptations.
Review source/load cases, exact models/settings and power-path/regulator transient behavior; simplified droop is screening only.
Measure bursts, minimum battery/input voltage, charging/NTC if applicable, startup/shutdown, temperature and actual pack/harness limits.

notes: Linear charger, not a switched converter and not cell protection. Review USB input-mode/current, charging tolerance, TS/pack NTC, actual protected pack and thermal dissipation.
